plugin.name: Onimusha 3 Fusion Fix
ResX.description: Width of the screen in pixels. 0 uses the desktop resolution.
ResY.description: Height of the screen in pixels. 0 uses the desktop resolution.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original aspect shows the movies as the game does, with their black bars. Fill enlarges them past the black bars around the picture until the picture fits the screen, without cutting anything off.
WindowMode.description: Choose fullscreen, a resizable window, or a borderless window covering the monitor. Applies immediately. Alt+Enter switches between fullscreen and the window mode.
SkipIntro.description: Skip publisher splashes and the startup logo movie. Save checks and their choices remain available. Story and attract movies still play. Restart to apply.
FOVFactor.description: Adjust the normal gameplay camera. 1.0 keeps its intended framing; higher values show more. Scripted and specialized views keep their own lens.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pause a windowed game while another application has focus. Fullscreen retains the game’s own focus handling.
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the pointer inside the active game window. Release it when the game loses focus or while moving or sizing the window.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto places the gameplay HUD at the screen edges. Choose a ratio to keep it in a centered box of that width. HUD proportions and native margins are preserved. Changes apply immediately.
SkipPressStart.description: Go straight to the title menu after startup. Restart to apply.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.presethelp: Vanilla keeps the startup screens and original video framing. Recommended and Enhanced skip startup screens and fit the whole movie picture. Window mode, resolution and HUD box are kept.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply some settings.
checkupdates.description: Check for a new fix version once when enabled. A notice appears in Plugins; FusionFixHub opens after the game exits if installed. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: An update for Onimusha 3 Fusion Fix is available. FusionFixHub will open after you exit the game.
update.availablesite: An update for Onimusha 3 Fusion Fix is available at fusionfix.io.
TextLanguage.description: Choose the language of the plugin settings. Auto follows the game. Accented translations use the Western font supplied with the game.
CutsceneBorders.description: Choose cinematic bars, side borders preserving the original 4:3 framing, both, or neither. Without side borders the cutscene view widens to the screen.
AnimatedCutsceneBorders.description: Keep the game’s border fade. Turn off for an immediate transition.
GamepadIcons.description: Auto uses Xbox labels for Xidi. Choose PlayStation for PlayStation button symbols. Keyboard controls remain available.
FPSLimit.description: Rendered frames per second: 0 is unlimited, -1 follows the monitor refresh rate, or choose 30–1000. Game logic stays at its original 60 ticks per second.
GameLanguage.description: Language of the game’s own text. Auto uses the installed language. Restart to load its text and fonts.
